title: Stationary comparisons at specified outer filtration bounds
statement: Let D(X,K) be any family of termwise etale hypercohomology presentations [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation] and let e identify each page with its actual filtered-complex cycle/boundary quotient [lem-weil-pbc-ce-stationary-page-naturality]. There are simultaneous isomorphisms eInf from page r at (q,n-q) to gr^q D.H_n whenever r>=1 and D.L^(q+r) in degree n+1 is bottom and D.L^(q-r+1) in degree n-1 is top [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. For every sections-total chain map b preserving the filtration steps and every sequence map N induced by b on graded cycle representatives, the conjugated homology map c_X^{-1} H^n(b) c_Y restricts to step maps t satisfying ht. For every proof hc of successive inclusion compatibility, on pages satisfying both outer-step equalities in source and target, N under eInf equals cokernel.map(t_(q+1),t_q,hc). No support bound, inverse-image map, augmentation or first-page formula is assumed or constructed.

proof.text: Substitute bottom and top for the outer steps in the cycle and boundary formulas. The resulting subquotient is canonically the quotient of cohomology images of successive steps; fix the isomorphism by the quotient-to-image equation on actual cycles, not by choosing an arbitrary stable isomorphism.

Transport the cohomology-image comparison by D.c and D.H_formula and compose with e. Its defining representative equation gives a simultaneous comparison for all q,n,r. Proof irrelevance removes dependence on the witnesses of the outer equalities.

The step factorizations of b induce homology maps on the cohomology images. Restrict and transport by c to give t and ht. Cancellation of the target step monomorphism gives successive inclusion compatibility.

The page representative equation and the canonical quotient-to-image comparison send every actual cycle to the same cycle image under b. The actual-cycle projections onto the stationary quotients are epi; cancel them to get the cokernel.map square. Its commutativity witness is irrelevant. This also covers zero steps and totals.
